name: jx-vscode
description: Jx Notation in VS Code: highlighting, completion from a project's schemas, and type checking of the code in a .jxn file

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../content-mapper build && bun build src/extension.ts --outfile=dist/extension.cjs --format=cjs --target=node --external=vscode && bun build ../content-mapper/bin/server.js --outfile=dist/mapper.mjs --format=esm --target=node

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting and completion work everywhere. The code in a .jxn file is type checked only in a trusted workspace, because checking it starts a program.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Highlighting works everywhere. Completion from a project's own schemas and type checking read the project from disk.
